Reviewing the plan and tracing the cited scripts and contracts in the repo.
schema_version	scope	severity	focus_area	location	what	scenario_or_breakage	suggested_fix
1	in_scope	important	correctness	skills/implement/SKILL.md:543-549	Removing the top-level step-5-entry.sh fence drops Step 5 telemetry-mark on the --self-review path	The plan deletes the unconditional entry fence and only calls step-5-review.sh inside the scripted loop. Self-review skips that loop but today still gets timing telemetry-mark --label "Step 5 — code review" from step-5-entry.sh. Self-review runs lose that mark and timing-ledger coverage regresses.	Add a self-review-only foreground fence before the self-review banner that runs the same telemetry-mark (e.g. bash "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/larch-run.sh" python/cli.py timing telemetry-mark --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" --label "Step 5 — code review"), or extract a minimal shared mark helper both paths call.
1	in_scope	important	risk-integration	scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.sh:37	Plan omits updating EXPECTED_NEW after removing one SKILL.md Bash fence	Removing the step-5-entry.sh fence and folding review-and-fix into step-5-review.sh reduces new-shape fence count from 31 to 30. test-implement-fence-shape.sh hard-fails on mismatch (make test-harnesses-3 / make lint). Acceptance cites structure harnesses staying green but the plan testing strategy does not list this harness.	Update scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.sh EXPECTED_NEW to 30, or add the self-review telemetry fence above so the net fence count stays 31.
1	out_of_scope	latent	architecture	skills/implement/SKILL.md:588-596	Banner moves from orchestrator text into immediate-background child stdout	The scripted-loop banner includes dynamic-archetypes cap=N before review-and-fix KVs. Token-aware parsing targets named keys, so cap=N is unlikely to break STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS extraction, but human prose now mixes with machine KV output for the whole Step 5 wait.	If a future parse bug appears, emit the banner on FD 3 or keep cap lines as structured KVs before exec; not required for this fold if named-key parsing stays authoritative.
